The Aji Course? Looks like it's a set of two appetizers, sashimi, mizutaki, and your choice of porridge or champon. I can't decide which I like more.
The Hana Course? It's a set of appetizers, a seasonal dish, sashimi, and dessert.
The Kinka Course? It's only available by reservation, and is sure to delight you with its huge variety of dishes.
The Hanamidori Mizutaki? It's a set including our famous mizutaki, appetizer, and sashimi. It goes well with a final course of porridge or champon.
The Mizutaki Karaage? The fried chicken soaks up all the juices of the mizutaki. It's one of our specialties.
Our house-made sauce goes perfectly with these juicy, mouth-watering Hanamidori Meatballs.
This pudding is packed with collagen from free-range chickens. It's great for your skin.
This salad is packed with collagen from free-range chickens. It's great for your skin.
This is our Hana Course. It comes with appetizers, a seasonal dish, porridge, sashimi, and dessert.
Welcome to tuna sushi paradise! This set includes prime fatty cuts, fatty cuts, lean cuts, negitoro, tuna rolls, and seared tuna.
Plenty of healthy vegetables, al dente noodles, and our flavorful brown sauce make this yakisoba out of this world.
This takoyaki is topped with rich cheese and mayonnaise, filled with real Hakata spicy fish roe. It's our number one best-seller with female customers.
Octopus seasoned with garlic oil and sprinkled with paprika. A favorite Spanish delicacy, best enjoyed over drinks.
Special extra-thick noodles with thick-sliced pork and plenty of bean sprouts are combined with a rich brown sauce.
This hot pot dish is made with domestically raised Japanese puffer. Enjoy it with our house ponzu dipping sauce, made with a secret recipe.
Enjoy our fresh, firm Japanese pufferfish sashimi.
Pickled crab, two kinds of crab sashimi, crab & egg custard, grilled crab, crab tempura, crab sushi, clear broth soup, and fruit.
Appetizers, clear broth soup, choice sashimi, assorted small dishes, a main course, a fried entrée, soups, sushi, and dessert.
Appetizers, clear broth soup, choice sashimi, assorted small dishes, a main course, a fried entrée, soups, choice sushi, and dessert.
This cocktail is a blend of shochu with yuzu syrup and soda water. It's topped with a yuzu preserve for the finishing touch.
Oolong tea, the quintessential nonalcoholic drink. Enjoy the fragrance and flavor of this distinctive tea.
The Kishu Nanko Plum Sour is a refreshing cocktail made with tart Kishu Nanko plums.
The Moscow Mule is a well-known cocktail of vodka, lime juice, and ginger ale.
The Gin and Tonic is a classic cocktail of gin mixed with tonic water and lime juice.
An extremely popular cocktail, Cassis & Orange is made with one hundred percent pure orange juice.
These chicken wings are seasoned with a special spice mix with just the right amount of sweetness. You can't eat just one!
A creamy parfait loaded with fresh strawberries. The anthocyanins lend it a pleasing, fruity hue.
As advertised, our delicious Beef Rice meal with miso soup is sure to please.
Beef Curry is a popular menu item, with tender chunks of beef and curry on one plate. Comes with miso soup.
The Beef Yakiniku Meal is one of our popular standard entrées on the menu. Juicy BBQ beef comes with rice, miso soup, and vegetables.
Our popular Kalbi Yakiniku Set is made with juicy BBQ rib meat and tasty sauce. Comes with rice, miso soup, and vegetables.
A hot, juicy hamburg steak topped with egg and sweet demiglace sauce, served with rice, miso soup, and vegetables.
Our Pork Yakiniku Meal has great-tasting pork for great stamina. Includes rice, miso soup, and fresh vegetables.
The Ginger Pork Meal comes with plenty of succulent pork, white rice, miso soup, and vegetables.
Sliced chicken is grilled up hot and juicy and paired with a perfectly matched sauce. Includes rice and salad.
This set includes a Teriyaki Smile Burger with special sauce, fries, and a drink.
As advertised, this set comes with a King Smile Burger, fries, and a drink.
A tasty Tuna Burger with a strange texture. Fries and a drink come with this set.
A tender stewed pork burger with fries and a drink.
A Smile Shake made with fresh milk. Sure to put a smile on anyone's face.
This meat is from the belly of the cow. It's popular for its incredibly rich flavor.
Beef back strap with a light flavor and relatively low in fat.
This beef skirt steak is actually considered to be entrails, but it is very popular.
Harami taken from top grade Japanese beef. An incredible treat for your taste buds.
Taste our egg sushi to get an idea of our overall quality. We take special pride in this.
Unbelievably fresh! This sweet shrimp will melt in your mouth.
Hirame, AKA olive flounder, is right in season. And ours is all-natural.
This kinmedai was freshly caught early this morning. It's oily and better than ever.
Can you tell natural and artificial salmon roe apart? This here's the best in the industry.
Did you know that akagai clams have red blood? Ancient records speak of an Akagai goddess named Princess Kisagahi.
Top-grade sea urchin straight from Numazu Port.
The Mozzarella Cheese Caprese is prepared from fresh tomatoes and mozzarella drizzled with light olive oil.
This octopus carpaccio is made with soft Hokkaido octopus and zesty ponzu sauce.
Spicy, bite-sized, Hawaiian-style Portuguese sausages. They go great with beer.
Spicy fries made by seasoning Hokkaido Matilda potatoes with chipotle salt.
Oven-roasted fragrant, spicy chorizo sausage seasoned with chipotle salt.
Bite-sized pieces of crunchy white fish paired with crispy french fries.
This gin-based cocktail is mixed with ginger ale and a squeeze of lime.
This drink is Kakubin mixed with lemon and soda. The "XL" refers to its size, so you can take your time drinking it.
The Light Kakubin Highball XL is a milder version of Kakubin Highball XL.
The Bronze Yamazaki Highball is Yamazaki whisky mixed with lemon and soda. Served in a copper tumbler to keep it cold.
Enjoy the fine flavor of this Macallan-based highball. A blend of three different liquors infused with Macallan's fine oak. Goes down smooth.
This delicious spaghetti dish is made with authentic, spicy fish roe from Hakata.
This is our rich carbonara, with a tasty soft-boiled egg on top of a creamy sauce.
